steps.text:
Found it! The "Case Routing Policy (rev. 2 — CURRENT)" says:

- Effective 2026-06-01, supersedes rev. 1.
- Issue categories are determined by the ticket subject prefix: "Billing discrepancy", "Problem updating", "Cannot access", "Question about".
- A new case routes to the ELIGIBLE agent who has completed (status resolved or closed) the most support tickets in the case's category.
- Eligibility: employees with status "active" only — agents on leave or terminated are never routed.
- Tie-break 1: fewer currently active tickets (open, in_progress, waiting_customer).
- Tie-break 2: earlier hire_date.

So "completed" means status "resolved" or "closed".

Now, the user asks: "identify the agent who completed the most support tickets opened between 2025-10-01 and 2025-12-31."

I need to:
1. Find all support tickets opened between 2025-10-01 and 2025-12-31
2. Among those, count which ones have status "resolved" or "closed" (per the policy definition of "completed")
3. Group by assignee (agent)
4. Only consider eligible agents (status "active", not on_leave or terminated)
5. Return the employee_number of the agent with the most completed tickets

Let me query support tickets first.
